hooks.prompt: If the target is source code, prefer MCP: Octocode LSP for definition/references, CodeGraphContext for callers/blast-radius, Repomix for directory overviews. Allow Read/Grep for non-code or multi-file regex.
If the Read request targets a directory overview question, use Repomix MCP to pack the directory instead of reading individual files. For single-file reads, allow normally.
